db_pattern.idempotent: always use CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS
db_pattern.owner_id_type: TEXT NOT NULL (stores req.lifeosUser.sub which is a JWT sub string, not a DB UUID)

auth_pattern.jwt_field: req.lifeosUser set by requireKey when Bearer JWT provided
auth_pattern.owner_id_guard: const ownerId = req.lifeosUser?.sub || null; if (!ownerId) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'jwt_required' });

node_globals.fetch: fetch — available globally in Node 18+, no import needed
node_globals.crypto_randomUUID: crypto.randomUUID() — available globally in Node 18+, no import needed

multer_pattern.memory_config: multer({ storage: multer.memoryStorage(), limits: { fileSize: N } })

ai_call_pattern.rule: NEVER import @anthropic-ai/sdk or @google/generative-ai. Use callCouncilMember from ctx.

storage_pattern.note: R2 is S3-compatible. region must be "auto".
storage_pattern.client_init: new S3Client({ region: 'auto', endpoint: process.env.STORAGE_ENDPOINT, credentials: { accessKeyId: process.env.STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID, secretAccessKey: process.env.STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY } })

registration_pattern.call_location: core/two-tier-system-init.js — add createXxxRoutes(app, routeCtx) in the route registration block after createCommandCenterRoutes
registration_pattern.import_location: core/two-tier-system-init.js — add import at top alongside other route imports
registration_pattern.server_js_import: server.js — add import alongside other route imports

transcription_pattern.language: hardcodes language: en — no language detection available in this version

non_goals: Inventing a new review process outside of the existing Council consensus protocol (`services/lifeos-gate-change-council-run.js`).
Discarding existing, proven infrastructure without justification.

acceptance_criteria: The system correctly renames 'Chair' to 'Presiding Steward' throughout relevant user-facing elements and internal references.
The system correctly renames 'Digital Twin' to 'Digital Imprint' throughout relevant user-facing elements and internal references.
The browser extension UI functions as a fallback display plane and always-available Body, while the Native Display Plane is canonical.
The TaskOrchestrator correctly generalizes the browser-only drive-channel session schema for universal use.
Template capture remains unchanged, but a new TemplateStore, runtime, and validation are added for replay-first compiled execution.
The term 'Capsule' is correctly namespaced, with 'Operational Capsule' referring to this blueprint's subtype, avoiding collision with existing 'Memory Capsule' and 'REP Capsule'.
